verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 22.96
verses.english: Linked Discourses 22.96

verses.pali: 10. Pupphavagga
verses.english: 10. Flowers

verses.pali: Gomayapiṇḍasutta
verses.english: A Lump of Cow Dung

verses.pali: Sāvatthinidānaṁ.
verses.english: At Sāvatthī.

verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Seated to one side, that mendicant said to the Buddha:

verses.pali: “atthi nu kho, bhante, kiñci rūpaṁ yaṁ rūpaṁ niccaṁ dhuvaṁ sassataṁ avipariṇāmadhammaṁ sassatisamaṁ tatheva ṭhassati?
verses.english: “Sir, is there any form at all that’s permanent, everlasting, eternal, imperishable, and will last forever and ever?

verses.pali: Atthi nu kho, bhante, kāci vedanā yā vedanā niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā sassatisamaṁ tatheva ṭhassati?
verses.english: Is there any feeling …

verses.pali: Atthi nu kho, bhante, kāci saññā yā saññā …pe…
verses.english: perception …

verses.pali: atthi nu kho, bhante, keci saṅkhārā ye saṅkhārā niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā sassatisamaṁ tatheva ṭhassanti?
verses.english: choices …

verses.pali: Atthi nu kho, bhante, kiñci viññāṇaṁ, yaṁ viññāṇaṁ niccaṁ dhuvaṁ sassataṁ avipariṇāmadhammaṁ sassatisamaṁ tatheva ṭhassatī”ti?
verses.english: consciousness at all that’s permanent, everlasting, eternal, imperishable, and will last forever and ever?”

verses.pali: “Natthi kho, bhikkhu, kiñci rūpaṁ, yaṁ rūpaṁ niccaṁ dhuvaṁ sassataṁ avipariṇāmadhammaṁ sassatisamaṁ tatheva ṭhassati.
verses.english: “Mendicant, there is no form at all that’s permanent, everlasting, eternal, imperishable, and will last forever and ever.

verses.pali: Natthi kho, bhikkhu, kāci vedanā …
verses.english: There’s no feeling …

verses.pali: kāci saññā …
verses.english: perception …

verses.pali: keci saṅkhārā …
verses.english: choices …

verses.pali: kiñci viññāṇaṁ, yaṁ viññāṇaṁ niccaṁ dhuvaṁ sassataṁ avipariṇāmadhammaṁ sassatisamaṁ tatheva ṭhassatī”ti.
verses.english: consciousness at all that’s permanent, everlasting, eternal, imperishable, and will last forever and ever.”

verses.pali: Atha kho bhagavā parittaṁ gomayapiṇḍaṁ pāṇinā gahetvā taṁ bhikkhuṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then the Buddha, picking up a lump of cow dung, said to the mendicants:

verses.pali: “ettakopi kho, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho natthi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṁ tatheva ṭhassati.
verses.english: “There’s not even this much of any incarnation that’s permanent, everlasting, eternal, imperishable, and will last forever and ever.

verses.pali: Ettako cepi, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho abhavissa nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, nayidaṁ brahmacariyavāso paññāyetha sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
verses.english: If there were, this living of the spiritual life for the complete ending of suffering would not be found.

verses.pali: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhu, ettakopi attabhāvapaṭilābho natthi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, tasmā brahmacariyavāso paññāyati sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
verses.english: But since there isn’t, this living of the spiritual life for the complete ending of suffering is found.

verses.pali: Bhūtapubbāhaṁ, bhikkhu, rājā ahosiṁ khattiyo muddhāvasitto.
verses.english: Once upon a time I was an anointed aristocratic king.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsītinagarasahassāni ahesuṁ kusāvatīrājadhānippamukhāni.
verses.english: I had 84,000 cities, with the capital Kusāvatī the foremost.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsītipāsādasahassāni ahesuṁ dhammapāsādappamukhāni.
verses.english: I had 84,000 palaces, with the Palace of Principle the foremost.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsītikūṭāgārasahassāni ahesuṁ mahābyūhakūṭāgārappamukhāni.
verses.english: I had 84,000 chambers, with the Chamber of the Grand Tower the foremost.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsītipallaṅkasahassāni ahesuṁ dantamayāni sāramayāni sovaṇṇamayāni goṇakatthatāni paṭikatthatāni paṭalikatthatāni kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇāni sauttaracchadāni ubhatolohitakūpadhānāni.
verses.english: I had 84,000 couches made of ivory or heartwood or gold or silver, spread with woolen covers—shag-piled or embroidered with flowers—and spread with a fine deer hide, with a canopy above and red pillows at both ends.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsītināgasahassāni ahesuṁ sovaṇṇālaṅkārāni sovaṇṇaddhajāni hemajālapaṭicchannāni uposathanāgarājappamukhāni.
verses.english: I had 84,000 bull elephants with gold adornments and banners, covered with snow gold netting, with the royal bull elephant named Sabbath the foremost.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsītiassasahassāni ahesuṁ sovaṇṇālaṅkārāni sovaṇṇaddhajāni hemajālapaṭicchannāni valāhakaassarājappamukhāni.
verses.english: I had 84,000 horses with gold adornments and banners, covered with snow gold netting, with the royal steed named Thundercloud the foremost.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsītirathasahassāni ahesuṁ sovaṇṇālaṅkārāni sovaṇṇaddhajāni hemajālapaṭicchannāni vejayantarathappamukhāni.
verses.english: I had 84,000 chariots with gold adornments and banners, covered with snow gold netting, with the chariot named Triumph the foremost.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa caturāsītimaṇisahassāni ahesuṁ maṇiratanappamukhāni.
verses.english: I had 84,000 jewels, with the jewel-treasure the foremost.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhu …pe… caturāsītiitthisahassāni ahesuṁ subhaddādevippamukhāni.
verses.english: I had 84,000 women, with Queen Subhaddā the foremost.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhu …pe… caturāsītikhattiyasahassāni ahesuṁ anuyantāni pariṇāyakaratanappamukhāni.
verses.english: I had 84,000 aristocrat vassals, with the commander-treasure the foremost.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhu …pe… caturāsītidhenusahassāni ahesuṁ dukūlasandānāni kaṁsūpadhāraṇāni.
verses.english: I had 84,000 milk cows with muslin halter and bronze pails.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhu …pe… caturāsītivatthakoṭisahassāni ahesuṁ khomasukhumāni koseyyasukhumāni kambalasukhumāni kappāsikasukhumāni.
verses.english: I had 8,400,000,000 delicate cloths of linen, cotton, silk, and wool.

verses.pali: Tassa mayhaṁ, bhikkhu …pe… caturāsītithālipākasahassāni ahesuṁ; sāyaṁ pātaṁ bhattābhihāro abhihariyittha.
verses.english: I had 84,000 servings of food, which were presented to me as offerings at daybreak and dusk.

verses.pali: Tesaṁ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā nagarasahassānaṁ ekaññeva taṁ nagaraṁ hoti yamahaṁ tena samayena ajjhāvasāmi—kusāvatī rājadhānī.
verses.english: Of those 84,000 cities, I only stayed in one, the capital Kusāvatī.

verses.pali: Tesaṁ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā pāsādasahassānaṁ ekoyeva so pāsādo hoti yamahaṁ tena samayena ajjhāvasāmi—dhammo pāsādo.
verses.english: Of those 84,000 palaces, I only dwelt in one, the Palace of Principle.

verses.pali: Tesaṁ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā kūṭāgārasahassānaṁ ekaññeva taṁ kūṭāgāraṁ hoti yamahaṁ tena samayena ajjhāvasāmi—mahābyūhaṁ kūṭāgāraṁ.
verses.english: Of those 84,000 chambers, I only dwelt in one, the  Chamber of the Grand Tower.

verses.pali: Tesaṁ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā pallaṅkasahassānaṁ ekoyeva so pallaṅko hoti yamahaṁ tena samayena paribhuñjāmi—dantamayo vā sāramayo vā sovaṇṇamayo vā rūpiyamayo vā.
verses.english: Of those 84,000 couches, I only used one, made of ivory or heartwood or gold or silver.

verses.pali: Tesaṁ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā nāgasahassānaṁ ekoyeva so nāgo hoti yamahaṁ tena samayena abhiruhāmi—uposatho nāgarājā.
verses.english: Of those 84,000 bull elephants, I only rode one, the royal bull elephant named Sabbath.

verses.pali: Tesaṁ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā assasahassānaṁ ekoyeva so asso hoti yamahaṁ tena samayena abhiruhāmi—valāhako assarājā.
verses.english: Of those 84,000 horses, I only rode one, the royal horse named Thundercloud.

verses.pali: Tesaṁ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā rathasahassānaṁ ekoyeva so ratho hoti yamahaṁ tena samayena abhiruhāmi—vejayanto ratho.
verses.english: Of those 84,000 chariots, I only rode one, the chariot named Triumph.

verses.pali: Tesaṁ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā itthisahassānaṁ ekāyeva sā itthī hoti yā maṁ tena samayena paccupaṭṭhāti—khattiyānī vā velāmikā vā.
verses.english: Of those 84,000 women, I was only served by one, an aristocrat maiden or a coquette.

verses.pali: Tesaṁ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā vatthakoṭisahassānaṁ ekaññeva taṁ vatthayugaṁ hoti yamahaṁ tena samayena paridahāmi—khomasukhumaṁ vā koseyyasukhumaṁ vā kambalasukhumaṁ vā kappāsikasukhumaṁ vā.
verses.english: Of those 8,400,000,000 cloths, I only wore one pair, made of delicate linen, cotton, silk, and wool.

verses.pali: Tesaṁ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā thālipākasahassānaṁ ekoyeva so thālipāko hoti yato nāḷikodanaparamaṁ bhuñjāmi tadupiyañca sūpeyyaṁ.
verses.english: Of those 84,000 servings of food, I only had one, eating at most a cup of rice with suitable sauce.

verses.pali: Iti kho, bhikkhu, sabbe te saṅkhārā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā.
verses.english: And so all those conditioned phenomena have passed, ceased, and perished.

verses.pali: Evaṁ aniccā kho, bhikkhu, saṅkhārā.
verses.english: So impermanent are conditions,

verses.pali: Evaṁ addhuvā kho, bhikkhu, saṅkhārā.
verses.english: so unstable are conditions,

verses.pali: Evaṁ anassāsikā kho, bhikkhu, saṅkhārā.
verses.english: so unreliable are conditions.

verses.pali: Yāvañcidaṁ, bhikkhu, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṁ, alaṁ virajjituṁ, alaṁ vimuccitun”ti.
verses.english: This is quite enough for you to become disillusioned, dispassionate, and freed regarding all conditions.”

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ.
